title: Efficacy and Safety of Subthreshold Micropulse Yellow Laser for Persistent Diabetic Macular Edema After Vitrectomy: A Pilot Study

groups.description: Pseudophakic eyes with persistent DME 6 months after vitrectomy for tractional DME, treated with SMYL (retreatment at 3 months when needed)
Matched eyes with persistent DME after vitrectomy, observed without treatment

exclusions.what: T3 Mean BCVA (ETDRS letters), rows R3 (SMYL) and R4 (control), columns C2-C4; T2 row R3 (the SMYL group again)
exclusions.reason: Inclusion required a follow-up of at least 6 months, the last tabulated visit (Methods), which makes a complete-case set; two of 56 SMYL patients lost at the 3-month visit were excluded (Results), and the article does not state that every eye of the control group completed follow-up. No record.

notes: Prospective comparative non-randomized pilot study; baseline is 6 months after pars plana vitrectomy for tractional DME.
The minimum follow-up criterion is worded 'after SMYL laser treatment' but is listed among the inclusion criteria of all eyes with persistent DME; it is applied to both groups.
BCVA measured with ETDRS charts at 4 m and scored as letters (Methods).
Central macular thickness and OCT angiography parameters are not extracted.
